scope: Current source classifications for S01-S04/P01-P04 at named query/transaction/model/publication boundaries; no future allocation, target interfaces or replication selection.

evidencePolicy.openedCurrentPass: Decisive query/transaction/mapper functions opened in this bounded pass; no runtime proof.
evidencePolicy.reusedPriorWorkerPassSameHead: Prior worker's read-needs/RPC/status checks at identical HEAD, explicitly labeled per pointer.
evidencePolicy.tableSets: readTables list explicit SELECT helper dependencies; writeTables list explicit INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE targets. Implicit database engine reads of write targets are not separately counted. Conditional branches do not imply all tables are touched each call. Named child foreign-key cascades are additional effects where called out.
evidencePolicy.columns: Meaningful column groups used by opened queries/decoders/writers, not an exhaustive per-column transitive audit. SELECT * still reads all columns of selected rows.
evidencePolicy.pureBoundary: Pure means repeatable query/decoding/fold given a coherent declared row set and every explicit ordered/runtime/time/policy input. This does not establish copied-data coherence, observation freshness, replay equivalence, write authority or current native/person facts.

transactionBoundary.constraint: Each named read/write closure uses the same prepared application-local database API. Membership capture and awaited Session runtime summary are outside the detail/display SQL closure; no combined atomic snapshot is established.

closures.name: deadline selection / existing scheduler wiring / timed maintenance / retired purge

sql.transaction: separate read deadline closure; write timed maintenance closure
sql.tableSetScope: Union of direct SQL and named helper branches opened for this closure; conditional tables remain conditional, not a claim every call touches every row.
sql.writeSetCaveat: Explicit SQL statement targets; request/event/state child cascades are additional schema behavior, not an exhaustive cascade audit.

Production composition injects ContinuousClock and Date wallNow. First successful ensureOpen refreshes deadline; send, settlement, setLine, retirement drain, sessionEnded and successful timed work refresh it subsequently.

purge deletes seven direct parent/state/order tables for due pane; child tables cascade by schema, not individually deleted in explicit loop.
Current write-union does not include all FK cascade targets; those are listed in child dependency closure.

refreshDeadline reads MIN of blocking ask deadline, live line expiry, retirement purge_after and settled request/notice visibility expiry. Its generation check suppresses stale reads; a nil deadline clears the current scheduler sleeper.

RepositoryRetentionScheduler retains one cancellable sleeper and one admitted validation task. schedule cancels/joins the prior sleeper; fire clears pending deadline before callback; successful callback's refresh may set the next deadline while validation runs.

refreshDeadline read failure is swallowed with later-demand retry; deadlineReached write failure publishes nothing and does not itself call refreshDeadline. No dedicated retry/backoff is present; a concurrent independently requested refresh may still have left pending work.

Service stop cancels membership/retirement ingress, joins scheduler shutdown, and attempts blocking-ask .appStopping settlement. Scheduler shutdown cancels/joins sleeper and awaits admitted validation.

Source classification only: once armed the scheduler can maintain rows without popover demand; this does not prove a never-opened or failed service progresses without another demand. Removing display read-side writes alone does not establish equivalent no-client behavior.
closures.remainingGap: Source-only scheduler/cancellation/failed-service liveness; no runtime timer execution or never-opened-client behavior observed. Full trigger/cascade behavior beyond the named schema relationships is not audited.

crossBoundaryFindings.claim: Status-context SQL reads seven table families including nested question/options and operation ordering. The runtime current status also depends on live binding confirmation, admitted monotonic instants, viewed/retired ingress, open asks, monitoring line and refusal memory; persisted evidence is a replay prerequisite, not the complete current projection.

Compact display uses five SQL tables and persists expiry/hiding; full detail has a pure SQL read over twelve table families, including seven message child tables. Both service entry points can perform opening/retirement side effects first.

Changes reports and acknowledges a writer-scoped position, confirms receipts and prunes retained events. Detail rendering does not acknowledge that stream; UI markRead and answer are explicit effects.
Generation end stales agent lines and changes pending receipts to unconfirmed. Ask open-summary sequence and answer-reported position are separate columns in the same pane_answer_position row family.
Present-view owner/drawer grouping and local consumer generations are distinct from session binding/evidence truth and from native host/window/surface availability.

Existing scheduler is lazily armed through ensureOpen/refreshDeadline and later mutations; timed commits run independently after arming, with no dedicated automatic retry loop after caught failures. Equivalent no-client behavior is not established by removing only read-side writes.

Canonical workspace graph's full persisted-table/restore closure; only current membership publication/source selection reused.
Every provider qualification/liveness producer, every SessionStatusReducer branch, provider spool/socket chain and all source generation transitions.
Optional Sessions commit participant and PaneContextCommitParticipant additional table writes.
Complete schema migration/trigger/cascade audit; named message child foreign-key relationships read, not every database object.
Every UI form/action effect, native actionRunner execution and full SwiftUI view tree.
Runtime timer liveness under failure, never-opened service progression, SQL isolation under concurrent live inputs and rendering/transport/application readiness.
